links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of AI versus EMS personnel against expert consensus for stroke deficits
links.effect: APOLLAI sensitivity higher than EMS for all five tasks and global assessment (78.5% vs 59.4%), with comparable specificity (87.0% vs 85.9%); global AUC 0.882.
links.quote: APOLLAI showed higher sensitivity than EMS for all five neurological tasks and for the global assessment (78.5% versus 59.4%), with broadly comparable specificity (87.0% versus 85.9% for the global assessment).

screen.reason: Evaluates a multimodal video/audio AI model (APOLLAI) compared to EMS clinician ratings on recorded patient encounters for detecting stroke deficits, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
